### Product Highlights

Scotland- Wonderfully refined with notes of citrus, spice and creamy milk chocolate. Dries nicely and builds with a beautiful nutty, cocoa and fruity finish. A complex yet balanced full of flavor single malt whiskey, matured for at least 30 years. Best enjoyed straight.
